label: ADG 5/5 Legit Terminals (High EE3)
source: ADG discord: 'How to create terminal roles' + 'Most Optimal 5/5 Legit Terminals (High EE3)' + full M7 green-yellow POV breakdown
notes: Term roles assume double skip ss, no levers in S2 for tank (4bl instead) and a fast hee3.
S1: healer leaps arch after ss, archer leaps mage after skip ss 21, tank leaps mage after 43.
Bers S1 is a double leap in the guide (arch/tank to stack melody at 6, then mage at 9).
Step 1 leaps archer, step 2 leaps mage; if you skip the melody leap just open the menu once.
S2: healer/archer/berserk all leap tank after their term. Tank stays at hee3 for the healer, mage walks 53.

S3: healer leaps mage, archer preleaps healer (guide default when tank leaps to you or you get levers; otherwise leap mage manually), tank leaps archer then mage after levers (step 2), berserk leaps healer.
Mage does core and is the destination for everyone, so nobody else leaps for core in this roleset.

S4: tank leaps mage after both levers, healer leaps mage (implied by the mage premove note), berserk leaps mage once he does i4 (instant dev at S4) - the mage is at his early-enter-2 spot in front of the levers dev.
Archer and berserk recore leaps are not specified in the guide and are left blank; mage recore needs no leap.
P1/P2 leaps below are the full M7 green-yellow route, broken down per POV.
P2.GY s1+s2 = crystal leaps: berserk leaps healer and archer leaps tank after each crystal grab (bers grabs his crystal again between the two leaps).

P2.GY s3 = repositioning: mage leaps the berserk at py dropoff, tank leaps the mage to start the yellow-pad manoeuvre, healer leaps the mage once their predev is done, archer drops to storm or leaps the berserk at py dropoff.
P2.GY s4 = purple prep: berserk finishes the S2 levers predev and leaps the tank at the yellow pad; archer leaps the mage to dps storm before the lightning.
P2.GY s5 = purple crush: after the lightning the mage leaps the healer, the healer steps on the pad then leaps the berserk.
P2.GY s6 = yellow crush: mage leaps the tank at yellow; storm dies here.
P2.GY s7 = after storm: mage, tank and archer all leap the healer standing at the simon says spot.
Tank s3 has an OR in the guide: leap the berserk at py dropoff instead of starting the mage manoeuvre - flip the tank cell in the planner if you run that side.
PREDEV: healer leaps the berserk waiting at the start of S1 during Storm (pre-dev for i4); other classes left to the user.
No conds ship with this preset, add your own in the condition editor.
